payload.recallText: hi, I am from providence rhode island. the most important thing to me is my family and the robert's. they are our whole world. they were irish and we were irish. they were catholic, and we were catholic. their tragedy and ours affected us deeply. when jfk was assassinated, we were broken. when in the car listening to the tenth anniversary of his assassination, my sister cried. I told my dad and he said, you should never feel embarrased to cry about that man. we used to vacation in the summer with my four aunts. they would rent a house on the beach in hyannis and they would do the same thing each day. they would make us lather them up in sunscreen adn they would use binoculars to spy on the kennedy's. each time they saw rose they would say, poor rose, she's so senile. then when a new person showed up, they would ask each other, who does she belong to? it must be one of jack's people but dont tell rose.
